current_answer: Claude Startups now offers approved bootstrapped as well as funded companies USD 1,000 in first-party Claude API credits, expiring six months after grant. A company must be founded within five years or funded within two, apply with a Claude Console account and a company-domain email matching its website, and pass Anthropic review. New Claude Team customers may also claim one free year for up to five Premium seats. The separate up-to-USD 45,000 partner stack is third-party offer value, not Claude credit or cash. The API credit does not cover Claude through AWS Bedrock or Google Vertex AI. Check the account route and country exclusions before planning spend.

catalogue_card.question: Can a bootstrapped startup get Claude API credits?
catalogue_card.text: It may apply for USD 1,000 in first-party Claude API credits, but approval is discretionary. Check the company-domain gate, country exclusions and six-month expiry. The USD 45,000 partner stack is separate offer value, not API credit or cash.

summary: Claude Startups now accepts bootstrapped applications and offers approved companies USD 1,000 in first-party API credits for six months.
A matching company-domain email, Claude Console account and review are required; a website and email alone do not guarantee approval.
New Team organisations may receive one free year for up to five Premium seats; third-party partner offers are separate.
NLnet’s 3 November form remains open; Interledger Local Impact remains paused.
uncertainty: Anthropic has not published an application cutoff or a full supported-country map on the pages checked.
The sign-in-gated form and account-specific billing after the six-month credit were not inspected.
One applicant reported rejection despite basic credentials; that is an individual report, not a program-wide approval rate.
